Metadata.title: Bruno Pinheiro — Senior Software Engineer
Metadata.description: Bruno Pinheiro is a software engineer in São Paulo with 10+ years of building products from scratch. Maker of Overcoded.

hero.name: Bruno Pinheiro
hero.role: Senior Software Engineer · Applied AI · São Paulo
hero.headline: For [[hl:more than 10 years]] I've taken ideas from zero to production.
hero.lead: Frontend, backend, integrations and whatever else it takes. Today on the SparkAI team at John Deere's Blue River Technology.

blueRiver.text: I work as a full-stack product engineer: from discovery to observability, I ship features [[hl:end to end, backend to frontend]]. I also own the team's [[hl:AI harness]], improving our workflows and building internal AI solutions. I helped take test coverage [[hl:from 40% to 80%]], [[ul:halve CI/CD time]] and raise our AI code review accuracy to [[hl:90%]].

pagaleve.text: On a BNPL checkout live in [[hl:200+ online stores]], I helped build the VTEX, Shopify and NuvemShop integrations, made it [[hl:load 40% faster]] and hardened the [[ul:security of the payment flow]].

gavea.text: As tech lead, I set the web, desktop and mobile frontend architecture and introduced CI/CD and automated testing at a commodities exchange whose blockchain handled [[hl:$4B in orders]].

globo.text: I led the sports prediction project and worked on ENEM exam grading, [[hl:used by millions of people]], some of it featured on TV.

b3.text: I helped move the [[ul:Bovespa Index rebalancing]] off a legacy system onto a modern, testable architecture.

oxxy.text: Where I started: end-to-end systems and automations for automotive operations, electronic fines, driving schools and condominiums.
